title: Why We Built Spritz
description: The internet was supposed to be a decentralized network—a place where anyone could communicate freely, share ideas, and build communities without gatekeepers. But somewhere along the way, we lost that vision. Today, a handful of corporations control our digital lives, deciding what we see, who we can talk to, and what we're allowed to say.
